learning_outcomes.text: Understand the importance of environmental management, developing the ability to work systematically.

syllabus_topics: Introduction, Development of Environmental Management: historical development, standardization, effectiveness.
ISO 14000 series standards. ISO 14001, ISO 14004, and others.
Implementation of ISO 14001 in a plant; Preparation of Instructions and Procedures, Determination and Preparation of Forms and other documents.
bibliography: Culley, W.C., Environmental and Quality Systems Integration, CRC Press LCC, 1998
Kuhre, W.L. ISO14000 Certification Environmental Management Systems, Prentice Hall International Series, 1995
ISO 14001, Environmental Management Systems - Specification with guidance for use, International Standard Organisation, Switzerland., 1996
